Definition: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fight, do battle, make war; 1a) (Qal) to fight, do battle; 1b) (Niphal) to engage in battle, wage war; 2) (Qal) to eat, use as food
